examples: The magic trick will amaze you.
Her fast running amazed us.
The big fireworks amaze me.

more.def: To fill someone with great surprise or wonder.
examples: The size of the whale amazed everyone on the boat.
It amazes me how many stars you can see in the desert.
The young chess player amazed the crowd with her skill.
The magic show was amazing.
What an amazing view!
She did an amazing jump.

more.def: So surprising or wonderful that it is hard to believe.
examples: The acrobats did amazing flips.
The view from the mountain top was amazing.
It is amazing how fast a cheetah can run.

easy.def: A truck that takes hurt people to the hospital.
examples: The ambulance came fast.
An ambulance has a siren.
The ambulance took her to the hospital.

more.def: A special vehicle that carries sick or hurt people to a hospital.
examples: The ambulance raced to the hospital with its siren on.
Cars pulled over to let the ambulance go by.
The helpers in the ambulance cared for the hurt man.

easy.def: A word said at the end of a prayer.
examples: They said amen at the end.
The class said amen together.
We all said amen.

more.def: A word used at the end of a prayer that means "may it be so."
examples: The people said amen when the prayer was over.
Everyone in the church said amen together.
He bowed his head and said amen.

easy.def: In the middle of a group.
examples: The cat was among the toys.
She sat among her friends.
A tree among many trees.

more.def: In the middle of or surrounded by a group of things.
examples: The cat hid among the boxes.
She sat among her friends at lunch.
A small cottage stood among the trees.

easy.def: How much there is of something.
examples: Add a small amount of salt.
A large amount of snow fell.
I saved a big amount of money.

more.def: The total quantity of something, how much of it there is.
examples: Use a tiny amount of glue so the paper does not wrinkle.
A huge amount of water flows over the falls each second.
The amount of homework changes from week to week.
